The region ID of the ACK cluster connector. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
- [DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList~~): Queries the list of synchronization node regions.

> For more information about the regions supported by ACK cluster connectors in Cloud Firewall, see [ACK cluster synchronization nodes](~~2865120~~).

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. This may affect your business. Manage your calls properly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-ack-cluster-connectors --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --member-uid 1358090477150000 --region-no cn-shenzhen --connector-name test --vpc-id vpc-uf6b5lyul0x000000 --cluster-id 0E0C30C9774630000 --lang zh --region cn-hangzhou
